name: b_syna_on_revised_deal_structure
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Story: ON–SYNA Revised Deal: Why $5.7B Cash vs Prior $7B Stock & Regulatory Path. Related tickers: ON, SYNA.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

Why this needs follow-up: ON revised its SYNA acquisition from ~$7B all-stock to $5.7B all-cash at $123/share after a competing third-party offer; the notes give no identity of the competing bidder, no detail on why the price fell while the structure shifted to cash, and no analyst view on ON's balance sheet impact.

ANSWER EACH QUESTION (run a separate search for each):
- Who made the competing third-party offer for Synaptics that prompted ON Semiconductor to revise its acquisition terms to $123 per share cash in October 2026?
- How does ON Semiconductor plan to finance the $5.7 billion all-cash Synaptics acquisition, and what leverage ratio or credit-rating impact have analysts projected?
- Which remaining regulatory approvals—beyond US antitrust clearance already obtained—are required before the ON–Synaptics deal closes by mid-2027?

Name every stock affected by this story with its move, analyst notes that name winners and losers
(firm, rating, PT), exact figures (deal values, estimates, dates), and the latest status as of the
cutoff. Prefer Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, company releases, filings.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or sub-topic:

## TICKER or Sub-topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## SYNA / Competing bidder `[M&A]`
- Synaptics received an **unsolicited, non-binding proposal from an unidentified strategic buyer**, designated **“Party A”** in its SEC filings, on **September 2, 2026**; the bidder’s identity and proposed price had not been disclosed by the October 5, 12:20 ET cutoff. [report] (TheStreet, Oct. 4 22:24 ET)
- Synaptics’ board determined that Party A’s revised proposal was a **Superior Proposal** under the original agreement, prompting ON Semiconductor and Synaptics to renegotiate; the amended agreement was signed on **October 1, 2026**. (Tech Times, Oct. 2 08:24 ET)
- ON Semiconductor revised the consideration from the **June 25, 2026 all-stock transaction valued at approximately $7.0 billion** to **$123 per Synaptics share in cash**, valuing the transaction at approximately **$5.7 billion**. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)
- The revised agreement was unanimously approved by the ON Semiconductor and Synaptics boards and is expected to close by **mid-2027**, subject to shareholder, regulatory and other customary closing conditions. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)

## ON `[Financing / balance sheet]`
- ON Semiconductor plans to finance the approximately **$5.7 billion** purchase with **cash on hand** and up to **$2.45 billion** of committed senior secured term-loan financing from **Morgan Stanley Senior Funding**, under an October 1 commitment letter. (ON Semiconductor SEC filing, Oct. 1)
- The amended merger agreement contains **no financing condition**, so ON’s ability to close is not conditioned on obtaining the committed debt financing. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)
- ON reported approximately **$3.9 billion of cash and short-term investments**, **$5.4 billion of total liquidity** and **$425 million of quarterly free cash flow** in the figures cited in the October 2 market coverage. (247WallSt, Oct. 2)
- The search results did not identify a published analyst estimate for ON’s post-transaction **leverage ratio** or a specific **credit-rating action** through October 5 at 12:20 ET.
- Baird analyst **Tristan Gerra** maintained a **Hold** rating on ON and a **$108 price target** after the revised agreement. (IBTimes Australia, Oct. 2)

## SYNA `[Regulatory / closing status]`
- The **U.S. Federal Trade Commission** had approved the transaction before the October 1 revised-announcement release; the companies said regulators in **other jurisdictions** were still reviewing it. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)
- The required remaining approvals were described publicly only as **regulatory approvals in other jurisdictions**; the available reports did not name the specific countries or agencies by October 5 at 12:20 ET. (Tech Times, Oct. 2 08:24 ET)
- Synaptics shareholders still must approve the transaction at a special meeting; the meeting date had not been announced in the available October 2–5 coverage. (Tech Times, Oct. 2 08:24 ET)
- The transaction remained targeted for completion by **mid-2027**, subject to Synaptics shareholder approval, remaining regulatory approvals and other customary conditions. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)

## ON `[Market move / analyst notes]`
- ON shares rose approximately **6%** on Friday, **October 2, 2026**, after the revised all-cash agreement was announced. (Investopedia, Oct. 2)
- ON shares were reported **6.5% higher in pre-market trading** on October 2 after the announcement. (Investing.com, Oct. 2)
- Baird’s **Tristan Gerra** kept ON at **Hold** with a **$108 price target**; no old-to-new rating or price-target change was reported. (IBTimes Australia, Oct. 2)
- An additional market-data item identified ON’s latest cited analyst view as **Buy** with a **$125 price target**, but it did not identify the firm or provide an action date. (Globe and Mail, Oct. 2)

## SYNA `[Market move]`
- SYNA shares rose approximately **14%** on Friday, **October 2, 2026**, following the switch from the approximately $7.0 billion all-stock agreement to the **$123-per-share cash** offer. (Investopedia, Oct. 2)
- SYNA shares rose **more than 14% at the open** on October 2 and traded close to the **$123 cash consideration**. (IBTimes Australia, Oct. 2)
- The revised cash consideration provides Synaptics shareholders with a fixed **$123 per-share value**, compared with the prior stock-based consideration whose aggregate transaction value had been approximately **$7.0 billion**. (onsemi, Oct. 1 08:00 ET)

## Other affected stocks `[Market scope]`
- The available October 2–5 reports identified **ON** and **SYNA** as the publicly traded stocks with reported price moves tied to the revised transaction; no other named stock was reported with a quantified move in the available coverage. (Investopedia, Oct. 2)
